mcc26.name: MCC, NEET-PG (MD/MS/DNB) Counselling 2026: Information Bulletin & Counselling Scheme, published 07/10/2026 and marked "PG Bulletin DRAFT – V10 05102026"

sch26.name: MCC, Tentative schedule for online counselling, NEET-PG 50% AIQ and 100% Deemed/Central Universities/AFMS, academic year 2026 (published 07/10/2026)

notes: MCC published its 2026 bulletin on 07/10/2026; its first page marks it "DRAFT – V10", so MCC may still revise it, and we'll update these lines if it does. New this year: after an allotment you're either Freeze (keep the seat and join at the college in person) or Float (upgrade, with willingness, documents and resignation all online).

r1.title: Round 1
who: Every NEET-PG qualified candidate who registers, paying a non-refundable registration fee and a refundable security deposit (refunded only to the account it was paid from).
Only clear-cut vacancies are shown in Round 1.

New in 2026: after an allotment you're either Freeze (you keep the seat and join at the college in person) or Float (you want to upgrade: give willingness online, and the college checks your uploaded documents online, with no visit). Both upload their documents once, on the MCC portal, within 2-3 days of the final allotment.

Tentative 2026 dates: register and pay from 12 to 21 October 2026 (registration until 12:00 noon on 21 October, payment until 3:00 PM); choices until 10:00 AM on 22 October; result 24 October; reporting and joining 26 October to 2 November.
sch26: p.1
opts: Report at the college in person with your originals and get admitted. Without willingness to upgrade, you keep this seat and you're out of Round 2.

Please note that in case you are satisfied with the seat allotted to you in Round-1 and do not give willingness for up-gradation in Round-2 as ‘Yes’, you will not be considered eligible for participating in Round-2 i.e. for up-gradation of your choice.

Join the seat online, give willingness to upgrade on the portal, upload your documents and tell the college's nodal officer by phone; you needn't go there. You keep this seat unless Round 2 gives you a better one.
he/she should join Round-1 seat online and give willingness for Up-gradation on the portal.
Not reporting counts as a free exit (Round 1 only). You can take part in Round 2 with your earlier registration, but you can't claim the Round 1 seat.
If a candidate does not report at the allotted institute in Round-1 freeze category, this will be considered as ‘Free Exit’ (option available only in Round-1).

Freeze candidates resign in person at the college, Float candidates online on the MCC portal, within MCC's time limit. In Round 1 it's a free exit and you can go on to Round 2, but you have no claim on that seat afterwards.
Once a seat is surrendered/resigned, candidate will have NO claim on that particular seat.
You take part in Round 2 without registering again.
If a registered candidate is not allotted a seat in round one (1), he can participate in round 2 directly without fresh registration.
gaps: a separate line that the deposit comes back after a Round 1 free exit: the bulletin's forfeiture rules start at Round 2, and refunds come only after all rounds.

r2.title: Round 2
who: Registered in Round 1 but no seat; Round 1 seat-holders who gave willingness to upgrade; those who took Round 1's free exit or resigned (no new registration); those whose Round 1 seat was cancelled at document verification over a changed category or PwD status; and new registrants.
Round 2 also shows virtual vacancies: Round 1 seats whose holders opted to upgrade, allotted only if they move up.

Tentative 2026 dates: register and pay 6 to 11 November 2026 (registration until 12:00 noon on 11 November, payment until 3:00 PM); choices until 10:00 AM on 12 November; result 14 November; reporting and joining 16 to 23 November.
sch26: p.2
opts: Your Round 1 seat is cancelled at once. Get the relieving letter online from the Round 1 college and join the Round 2 seat; if you don't, you lose the deposit, and the Round 1 seat is already gone.
the seat allotted during the first round will be automatically cancelled immediately
Report in person and get admitted. You keep the seat and you're out of Round 3.
Candidates who are holding any seat in Round-1 or Round-2 of AIQ and have not given willingness to upgrade in round 3 will not be eligible.
Upload your documents online at the allotted college first, then give willingness to upgrade to Round 3. You keep this seat unless Round 3 gives you a better one.

Candidates who have been freshly allotted a seat in round 2 can opt for willingness to upgrade from round 2 to round 3, for which first they will have to upload documents online at the allotted college/institute and thereafter opt for willingness.
Exit with forfeiture: the deposit isn't refunded. You may register for Round 3 again, paying the fees afresh.
Candidate who has been allotted a seat in Round-2 and further Round but do not report at the college may Exit with Forfeiture.
Freeze candidates resign in person at the college, Float candidates online, within MCC's time limit. In Round 2 this costs the deposit. You may still register for Round 3, paying the full fees.
Have Resigned from Round 2 can participate with full payment of fees.
You take part in Round 3 without registering again.
Those who registered but were not allotted a seat in Round-1 & Round-2 need not register again.

r3.title: Round 3
who: New registrants; those registered but never allotted; those who resigned from Round 2 or exited with forfeiture (paying the fees again); and Round 1 or Round 2 seat-holders who gave willingness to upgrade.
Vacant reserved seats are converted in Round 3: PwD seats to their category, ST to SC, SC to UR, EWS to UR, NRI and minority seats to UR.

Tentative 2026 dates: register and pay 26 November to 1 December 2026 (registration until 12:00 noon on 1 December, payment until 3:00 PM); choices until 10:00 AM on 2 December; result 4 December; reporting and joining 5 to 12 December.
sch26: p.3
opts: Final: report in person. You can't upgrade or resign, and holding a seat keeps you out of the Stray round.
Once joined, he cannot upgrade or resign from this third-round seat.
You lose the deposit and you're out of MCC's later rounds.
If any candidate does not join Round 3 seat, he may exit with forfeiture of security deposit and elimination (cannot participate in further rounds of counselling conducted by MCC, DGHS).
Your Round 1 or Round 2 seat stays yours: report to it in person after the Round 3 result.
After Round-3 provisional allotment result declaration → Mandatory reporting for all allotted candidates of Round 3 and Float Candidates of Round 1 / Round 2 who did not get upgradation.
You can take part in the Stray round.
If a candidate freshly registers in round 3 and is not allotted any seat, he/she is eligible to participate in stray/further rounds.
gaps: whether "full payment of fees" for those who resigned or exited in Round 2 means both the registration fee and the deposit again.

stray.title: Stray round
who: Only candidates holding no seat anywhere (AIQ, state or deemed), or who didn't take part in Rounds 1-3; fresh registration is open.
Not those freshly allotted a Round 3 seat who didn't join.
Fresh registration and fresh choices: Round 3 choices don't carry over.

Tentative 2026 dates: register and pay 16 to 21 December 2026 (registration until 12:00 noon on 21 December, payment until 3:00 PM); choices until 11:55 PM on 21 December; result 24 December; reporting and joining 24 to 31 December.
sch26: p.4
opts: Report and join the seat; if you don't, you lose the deposit.
If a candidate is allotted a seat in Stray round, he/she has to report & join the allotted seat at college/institute else there will be forfeiture of security deposit.
gaps: whether a joined Stray-round seat can be resigned: the 2026 bulletin doesn't say.

after.title: Leaving the course
gaps: any bond or penalty for leaving an all-India, deemed, central or DNB seat, other than losing the security deposit when you don't join or surrender from Round 2. MCC says fee, bond and service details come from the colleges: check the college's and the state's rules.

r1: Allotted a state seat as well? To take it, resign your MCC seat: online if you're Float, at the college if you're Freeze. In Round 1 that's a free exit.
Wants to join State allotted seat, candidate will have to surrender AIQ seat.
r2: Taking a state seat after joining an MCC Round 2 seat means resigning it, and in Round 2 that costs the deposit.
Round 1 - Free exit Round 2 - With Forfeiture
r3: After the states' Round 3, MCC and the states share data, and anyone on a state's list after its Round 3 is removed before MCC's Stray round.

Data will be shared between Centre and States after Round 3 of states and if any candidate has his/her name in the list provided by State after round 3, such candidates will be eliminated from counseling before processing for All-India Stray Vacancy Round.

reg: AIQ: Rs 1,000 (UR/EWS), Rs 500 (reserved). Deemed: Rs 5,000. Non-refundable. Applying for both: pay only the deemed fee. No separate row for central institutes.
dep: AIQ: Rs 25,000 (UR/EWS), Rs 10,000 (reserved). Deemed: Rs 2,00,000. Applying for both: pay only the deemed deposit.
lose: From Round 2: an allotted seat you don't join, or a seat you surrender. In any round: an admission cancelled (wrong information, missing documents).
back: After all rounds end, to the account you paid from, without interest. MCC publishes the list of candidates due a refund, and the Financial Custodian (HLL Lifecare) completes it within 30 days of that list.
leave: Not in the bulletin, except AFMS seats: civilian candidates serve 5 years in the AFMS, under a Rs 60,50,000 bond (MD/MS/DNB, session 2026-29) if they won't take the commission. Check the state's and the college's rules.
